summary: John's 4th cousin 6x removed; his family held the 'Caleb place' until 1907.
bio: Married Sarah, daughter of Caleb Smith II. His memorial stands in the northeast corner of the Methodist churchyard just outside the square of evergreens (Wood pp. 87–88). His son Joshua B. Smith died in 1907, 'the last Bull Smith to live in Hauppauge'.
